query: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.scans (id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT timezone('utc'::text, now()) NOT NULL, product_name TEXT NOT NULL, analysis TEXT NOT NULL); ALTER TABLE public.scans ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Servicio total" ON public.scans; CREATE POLICY "Servicio total" ON public.scans FOR ALL USING (true) WITH CHECK (true);
